If sentiment is >0.67 in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to avoid over-optimism.  
If sentiment is <0.33 in the last 3 days, increase forecast by 0.5–1.5% for mid horizon (8–15 days) to compensate for bearish bias.  
If sentiment spikes to 1.00 in the last 2 days, reduce forecast by 1.0–2.0% for late horizon (16–30 days) to prevent overcorrection.  
If sentiment is flat (0.33–0.67) across last 5 days, apply linear decay correction: subtract 0.1–0.3% per day for late horizon to smooth out noise.  
If forecast exceeds true value by >2% for 3 consecutive days, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.0% per day for remaining horizon to avoid runaway bias.  
If true value dips below forecast by >1.5% for 2 consecutive days, increase forecast by 0.5–1.0% per day for remaining horizon to correct lagging underestimation.
